caption: The drawing depicts a round bowl with smooth, gently curving sides, supported by a base formed from branch-like structures with multiple offshoots. Perched on one of the branches, adjacent to the rim of the bowl, is a bird with wings partially spread as if about to take flight or just landed. The bird's feathers are individually detailed, and its tail extends straight outward. The entire composition is rendered in shades of grey and black pencil on a plain, light-colored background. The drawing emphasizes shading to create depth and texture in both the bowl and the bird, while the surface upon which these objects rest is not illustrated. There is a signature at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Card Tray
